description:
Public Facebook Page/profile metadata from Open Graph tags: name, bio, image and (for Pages) like/follower/talking-about counts.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: username (string), name (string), like_count (integer, nullable), follower_count (integer, nullable), talking_about_count (integer, nullable), bio (string), profile_url (string), profile_image_url (string, nullable).

username.description: Page/profile vanity name, numeric profile ID, or facebook.com URL. Example: "cristiano"

name: facebook_profile
title: Facebook page
